description: Per-Z=72 shard of the recursive atom-knot atlas. Element: Hf. Covers every (Z=72, N) in AME 2020. Each row carries: prediction_type ∈ {mass, binding_energy}; the prediction value (from L1 canonical |tr_M| via markov_peel+mpmath, OR L2 α-cluster recursion); the AME 2020 reference; err in MeV / % / ppm; L4 composite mass M = N·m_n + Z·m_p − B (when nucleon masses + B are available). L1 source: canonical-mass-table-extended.witness.json; L2 source: alpha-cluster-recursion.witness.json; nucleon masses: m-p-borromean-verification-50dps.witness.json.
